basic_details.short_information: Mizoram University (MZU) has published the Recruitment 2026 notification for the post of Director. Applications by email will be accepted till 11 December 2026.

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

qualification.education_qualification: Master’s Degree in Engineering, Technology or Science with 25 years of experience in technology domains/defence.
qualification.details: Director: Master’s Degree in Engineering, Technology or Science from a recognized University with 25 years of experience in technology domains/ defence (technical domain). Desirable: PhD degree in Engineering, Technology or Science from a recognized University; wide-ranging experience and exposure to collaborative projects, setting up of large research facilities, strategic research planning and technology transfer; exposure to multi-mode projects across Labs/ Organizations/ Academia/ Industry interactions; experience in defence domain in terms of research/ coordination and technology development/ deployment; exposure to Academic and Industry oriented research/ coordination towards realization of technology/ systems.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 1,72,200 – 1,99,600/- based on experience, plus other allowances as applicable.
salary_details.details: Director: Rs. 1,72,200 – 1,99,600/- for non-Govt employees; pension adjustment for retired Govt employees.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MZU Director Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application by email to [email protected].
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-12-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Mizoram University (MZU) is conducting this recruitment drive for the post of Director at DIA-CoE on a contract basis located in Aizawl, Mizoram.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post name in this Mizoram University recruitment notification is Director, with a total vacancy count of 1 position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Mizoram University Director Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email for the Director post at Mizoram University is 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Director post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s Degree in Engineering, Technology or Science from a recognized University along with 25 years of experience in technology domains or the defence sector.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Mizoram University Director Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Director position should be below 62 years of age as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Director position?
faq.answer: The salary for non-government employees ranges from Rs. 1,72,200 to Rs. 1,99,600/- per month, while retired government employees will receive pension adjustments.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this job opening?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending their detailed CV in PDF format, along with a brief statement of suitability and required documents, via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of selection for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Director post at Mizoram University includes an application screening stage followed by a reference check.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned or required to be paid for submitting the application form as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract for the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The initial appointment is for a period of 3 years, which is extendable by an additional 2 years subject to a satisfactory performance review.
